item.description:
Our Beliefs

Saraff Group firmly believes that opportunities given by the almighty to those successful in life’s definitions of achievements have a morale responsibility to contribute towards the betterment of the society. item.title: Saraff Biogas Energies Co., Ltd
item.description:
Saraff Biogas Energies Co., Ltd, has been incorporated with the vision of an integrated plant tapping the full economic value of renewable resources. Saraff Biogas Energies Co., Ltd is dedicated to maintaining the highest levels of ethical business standards, while providing clean energy with the main goal of sustaining the environment and improving the general standard of living.The Plant is managed by a team of professionals who have extensive experience in the operation of Plant Equipment and Maintenance. SBEL philosophy is to leverage the current environment resources to provide clean energy .

VISION:

To excel and expand in Renewable Energy Business.

item.title: SARAFF ENERGIES Ltd
item.description:
Saraff Energies Ltd, has been incorporated with the vision of being a formidable player in the clear, green energy sector. To contribute in the growing Energy sector and keeping a healthy respect for the prevailing environment, the SARAFF GROUP launched two projects, aiming to achieve 200MW of power in next few years, through its own innovative ways. The immediate objective of Saraff Energies is to complete its flagship plant based on non conventional (agricultural waste) fuel. The Power Plant is managed by a team of professionals who have extensive experience in the operation of Power Plant Equipment and Maintenance.SEL philosophy is to leverage the current environment resources to provide clean energy .

VISION:

To excel and expand in Renewable Energy Business.

item.title: Chairman's Message
item.description:
The Saraff Global is a group that is developing with each passing year.

I have a vision, whereby the Saraff Group would grow to be one of the leading industrial groups based in Thailand. We have embarked on this journey and I believe that we have the right elements in place to ensure that this goal will be achieved in time to come. In today's business environment being focused on the customer needs and designing products to satisty those needs are basic business mantra. However, we tend to lose sight of instilling the basic fundamental elements of integrity, honesty, and total commitment through out the organization. We have instilled these elements from the start and are proud to say that we are moving forward with the right platform and focus.

item.title: KISEKII C DIAMONDS CO., LTD.
item.description: KISEKII C DIAMONDS CO., LTD. Saraff Global has been in the diamond trading industry since its inception in 1987, With its 40 years of experience in Diamond trading, in 2022 they looked into setting up Lab-grown diamond industry which would be first of its kind in Thailand. Lab-Grown diamond or “Green Diamond” are as real as diamonds mined from the earth. Lab grown diamonds are identical to earth mined diamonds in every way, except that they are grown in a lab. The trial production will start from April 2023 and full scale commercial production to be online by July 2023.
